entries.text:
# Short Obligatory Prayer
## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon.

Nawandak shi'ji, shiVit'eegwijyaahcy'aa shoqhtsiji naanhashandaiti ts'a nats'a' khaghibijyaa geenjit. Juk geegwaidak ts'a kaan, nat'aii nitsii shigéhdan ñooney'àa nidehte gwintsiì.
Neeghaú ña K'eegwaadhạt gwanlij kwa goqwajạt daj'gwits'iinya. Khik gwandaii gin-fji.
